five_grounds.name: language and counterevidence
five_grounds.finding: The two groups are three mental paths and seven bodily/verbal deeds which are also paths. LAS is the deed noun, KYANG is additive, and the introductory demonstrative refers to the preceding ten. Final YIN is overt in the seven-deeds predicate while English prints are only in Three are paths; this is a compressed copula/ellipsis correspondence, not evidence that the verse is false or incomplete.
